scheme_name: SMILE - Comprehensive Rehabilitation For Welfare Of Transgender Persons
other_conditions: Must have a Transgender Certificate issued through the National Portal for Transgender Persons of the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
Must not be receiving any other central or state government‑funded Pre‑Matric/Post‑Matric scholarship
Must be a regular, full‑time student studying in a government school or a school recognised by the government or a Central/State Board of secondary education
Scholarship is available for only one year per class; students repeating a class are not eligible for that class again
If the student migrates to another school/institute, a migration certificate from the competent authority must be submitted
benefits_summary: A scholarship of ₹13,500 per year is provided to eligible transgender students in secondary and senior secondary education.
